name: Mira
source:
Ariana's little sister.

She hunts mainly with a knife. Although she secretly harbors feelings for Ariana, she does not want anything more than a sisterly relationship with Ariana at the moment.

She is often reckless and makes Ariana worry in order to keep her close to him. She is happy even when she is angry with Ariana.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mahara_simai/sisters_top.html]official site[/url]]
